text: Linked interfaces shall agree on nominal identities/signatures/effects, storage/pointer/function layouts, space/conversion/device/atomic domains, ABI/attributes, helper/preservation/runtime/execution contracts, lifecycle coordinator metadata, relocation/object/environment constraints, and required CPU features. CPU names or pointer widths alone shall not establish compatibility.
